reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Amazing burgers! The best in Long Beach. Worth the wait even during lunch rush. Great for a quick bite between classes.

reviews.author: Mike J.
reviews.text: Great food but service is slow. Long waits, especially on weekends. Food quality is consistently good though.

reviews.author: Jessica P.
reviews.text: Perfect spot for a quick lunch between classes. Close to campus. The pulled pork sandwich is incredible.

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.text: Solid burgers and good prices for CSULB students. Gets crowded during lunch hours. Highly recommend their fries.

reviews.author: Emily R.
reviews.text: Food is good but parking is a nightmare. Had to circle for 15 minutes. Not ideal for a quick lunch break.

reviews.author: Alex T.
reviews.text: Fresh sushi, great prices. Students love it! Best sushi near CSULB campus. Definitely worth the visit.

reviews.author: Nina K.
reviews.text: Best sushi near CSULB campus. Highly recommend the spicy tuna roll. Their chirashi bowl is excellent too.

reviews.author: Tom W.
reviews.text: Excellent quality and super friendly staff. The chef remembers regulars. Great spot for study dates.

reviews.author: Rachel G.
reviews.text: Really good sushi at reasonable prices for the area. Sometimes gets busy but service is always friendly.

reviews.author: Brian S.
reviews.text: Solid choice for dinner near campus. Fresh ingredients and good portion sizes. The California rolls are generous.

reviews.author: Carlos M.
reviews.text: Amazing Mexican food! The best sandwiches and burritos near campus. Affordable prices for students.

reviews.author: Sofia R.
reviews.text: Great flavor and generous portions. Their carne asada is excellent. Gets crowded after 5pm on weekdays.

reviews.author: Marcus P.
reviews.text: Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. Good quality ingredients. The al pastor tacos are outstanding.

reviews.author: Laura J.
reviews.text: Solid Mexican spot near CSULB. Fast service during lunch hours. Good vegetarian options available.

reviews.author: Kevin T.
reviews.text: Food is good but parking situation is bad. Had to park a block away. Limited seating inside.

reviews.author: Anthony N.
reviews.text: Best pizza in Long Beach! Authentic Italian flavors. Great for groups and study sessions with friends.

reviews.author: Maria G.
reviews.text: Delicious handmade pasta and fresh ingredients. Their carbonara is perfect. Worth every penny.

reviews.author: Frank D.
reviews.text: Solid Italian spot. Good portions and reasonable prices. The lasagna is fantastic.

reviews.author: Lucia B.
reviews.text: Great place for dinner near campus. Authentic recipes. Their tiramisu is amazing for dessert.

reviews.author: Peter S.
reviews.text: Good food but can be pricey. Service can be slow during peak hours. Still worth trying though.

reviews.author: Jennifer K.
reviews.text: Great sandwiches and coffee! Perfect for breakfast or lunch between classes at CSULB. Very affordable.

reviews.author: Ryan P.
reviews.text: Good quality food and friendly staff. The turkey sandwiches are excellent. Great study cafe vibes.

reviews.author: Michelle D.
reviews.text: Nice cafe atmosphere. Their breakfast burritos are delicious. Good for a quick breakfast before class.

reviews.author: Thomas C.
reviews.text: Solid choice for quick lunch. Good variety of sandwiches. The coffee is decent and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Amy L.
reviews.text: Decent sandwiches but lines can get long during lunch hours. Service could be faster sometimes.
